history.summary: POSSIBLE DUPLICATE of seq 617 / 'Markandeya Temple' - this CSV row refers to the same real temple. Research for this file was drawn from the seq 617 record. This is the Sri Markandeya Mandir at Siddheshwar Peth (Siddheshwar Mandir Road, Modi Khana), Solapur city - the temple of the Padmashali (weaver) samaj, dedicated to Shri Markandeya Mahamuni, the sage himself, as the community's patron deity. It must NOT be confused with the ancient Markandeshwar/Markanda temple complex at Markanda, Chamorshi in Gadchiroli district, Vidarbha (a Hemadpanthi 8th-12th-century Shiva temple group on the Wainganga river, called the 'Khajuraho of Vidarbha') - a different temple several hundred km away.

town_description: Solapur is a city and municipal corporation in south-eastern Maharashtra, near the Karnataka border, and the administrative headquarters of Solapur district. It is a melting pot of Marathi, Telugu and Kannada cultures, a major railway junction on the north-south line, and a textile centre famous for Solapuri chaddars (bed-sheets). Pilgrim centres nearby include Pandharpur (Vithoba) and Akkalkot (Swami Samarth).
tradition: Hinduism (Padmashali samaj community temple dedicated to Sage Markandeya)

travel.airport: Nearest major/international airport is Pune (~230-250 km, roughly 4 hours by road). Solapur's own airport has only limited domestic services (verify current connectivity before planning).
travel.railway: Solapur Junction (station code SUR), on the Mumbai-Hyderabad main line, a major railhead; the temple at Siddheshwar Peth is a short auto/taxi ride from the station (verify distance).
travel.road: Centrally located at Siddheshwar Peth, Modi Khana, on Siddheshwar Mandir Road, Solapur-413007; easily reached by auto-rickshaw, taxi and city bus within Solapur.

visitor_information.best_time: October to February for pleasant weather. Narali Pournima (July-August, Rathotsav) and Markandeya Jayanti/Janmotsav (January-February) are the most festive times to visit.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Daily 6:00 AM to 8:45 PM, open all days (reported by two local listings; verify on site). No entry fee reported (verify); remove footwear before entering.
